description: A forward operating base commander must publish the day's access schedule for four routine support activities, assign the appropriate gate for a scheduled delivery, and record the coordination actions needed before the work begins.

shared_context.S1: The base has four support activities on today's access board: a POL-yard contractor visit, a communications-annex inspection, a medical cold-room inspection, and a bulk-water delivery.
shared_context.S2: The facility access team can support only one scheduled activity at a time, and all four activities must be placed within the 0700-1600 operating day.
shared_context.S3: The base has an east gate and a west gate; both gates are normally available for authorized support traffic.
shared_context.S4: Col. Morgan signs the final daily access schedule and any gate-control instructions.
shared_context.S5: As part of the routine morning facility board, each functional lead reports changes to their activity before Col. Morgan signs the schedule.

PF1.text: Maj. Singh confirmed with the POL contractor this morning that the contractor's access window is exactly 0730-0900 today; the confirmation is in the facilities email queue but has not yet been added to the access board.

PF2.text: Lt. Alvarez confirmed that the communications-annex inspection requires the access team from exactly 1300-1500 because the network technicians will be on site then; the technician confirmation arrived after the board draft was printed.

PF3.text: Capt. Brooks confirmed that the medical cold-room inspection must occur exactly 0930-1030 today before the scheduled temperature-log handoff; the medical warehouse posted the requirement this morning but it has not reached the facilities board.

PF4.text: Sgt. First Class Okafor received a higher-headquarters access directive this morning reserving the east gate from 1100-1200 for a partner delegation; the bulk-water delivery must therefore use the west gate during its 1100-1200 delivery window, and the directive has not yet been disseminated to the daily board.

acceptance_conditions: The POL contractor must be scheduled for exactly 0730-0900 and that confirmed window must be cited.
The communications-annex inspection must be scheduled for exactly 1300-1500 and that technician availability must be cited.
The medical cold-room inspection must be scheduled for exactly 0930-1030 and that temperature-log handoff constraint must be cited.
The bulk-water delivery must be scheduled for exactly 1100-1200 and must use the west gate.
The higher-headquarters gate directive must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The contractor confirmation changes the POL activity to the exact 0730-0900 window and supplies the fact that must be cited for that scheduling choice.
The technician availability changes the communications inspection to the exact 1300-1500 window and supplies the fact that must be cited for that scheduling choice.
The temperature-log handoff changes the medical inspection to the exact 0930-1030 window and supplies the fact that must be cited for that scheduling choice.
The higher-headquarters reservation fixes the water delivery at 1100-1200 through the west gate and supplies the directive that must be cited.
